reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent actually viewed the full exact source, complete unchanged raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet and naiwa reference; inspected native-resolution fedora, hair, eyewear, moustache/mouth, pipe and collar details and verified evidence/source/output/prompt/task/request/result/sheet SHA-256 and image-metadata bindings with read-only Python

entries.positive_observation: The tan/brown fedora retains its wide black ribbon, broad brim and original crop. Native detail confirms short dark temple hair and sideburn, dark eyebrows and two round thin wire-rimmed spectacles. The green-ringed solid black eyes have no added sclera and retain the image-right gaze; no human nose, ears or skin were added. The large dark-brown handlebar moustache retains curled tapered ends, the chin remains smooth without a beard, and exactly one mouth is closed on one curved dark-brown pipe projecting toward image right. The image-right three-quarter pose, directional light and upper-chest crop remain. The dark brown overcoat retains its raised broad collar/lapels, cream pointed shirt collar and dark tie. The short broad neck has continuous collar contact without pinching, floating cloth or an added cream bib. The complete dark brown/charcoal backplate retains its gradient and low-key illumination without a frame, note, halo or replacement studio.
entries.alpha_decision: Approve the RGB art only for a later source-alpha BILINEAR repair. The unchanged return is RGB with returned_alpha_extrema=null, while the source is fully opaque RGBA with extrema [255,255]. The recorded working-pass route therefore still requires its source-compatible RGBA derivative before production. The complete raw and white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet show a complete opaque backplate with no visible holes, lost backing or transparent exterior. No alpha repair was performed in this review.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine pipe grain and the exact coat-collar seam work are not reliably readable at 156x210. Their major visible shapes, positions and counts were checked directly, and no approval rests on a claim of exact unreadable texture or stitching.
